triggerReasons.message: Request has a structural multi-deliverable signal, so milestone coverage must be countable.
A milestone ledger exists, so every ledger row needs checklist and verificationIntent coverage.
High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Bug, regression, security/auth/session, benchmark, or explicit behavior-change work should have red evidence.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: verification_run executes a pinned verifier and stamps a receipt in one step (caller never authors the command)
acceptanceBindings.note: CHK-001 delivers the ergonomic on-ramp; result derived from the receipt.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: stale-evidence refresh re-executes the pinned command and re-issues a real receipt, or leaves the row demoted on failure (no laundering)
acceptanceBindings.note: Additive with B-3b88; re-execution routes through the same enforceAndStampEvidence refusal path.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: a fail-open PreToolUse guard denies a pin-mismatched evidence write on both Claude and Codex hosts while the B-ec67 handler stays the real floor
acceptanceBindings.note: Codex hook gated on the real emitted shell-tool name via e2e; handler refuses even when hook bypassed.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: one registered RED-first mutation-killing smoke proves verification_run, refresh re-execution, and the guard verdict through their real entry points
acceptanceBindings.note: The behavioral proof of all three; registered in validate.

note: B-1507 acceptance bindings: all four deliverables are core; none may be withdrawn to obtain an empty-scope PASS.
